broker.ptyBehavior: Accepts an inherited controlling PTY and transfers its foreground process group to the PRoot child.
broker.ownerMonitor: Kernel parent PID relation, with optional /proc start-time revalidation; three consecutive 100ms ownership misses force cleanup
broker.parentDeathSignal: None for the app owner; SIGTERM remains on the broker-to-PRoot child edge
broker.gracefulSignal: Kotlin targets the verified Node PID, then broker sends TERM to PRoot child only
broker.descendantCleanup: Subreaper-owned descendants receive TERM/KILL without same-UID name sweeps.
